hints.title: Segment Tree Maintenance
hints.text: Each segment tree node represents an interval and stores the length of the longest repeating substring.

hints.title: Node Attributes
hints.text: Store total length, left prefix char and length, right suffix char and length, and overall maximum repeating length.

hints.title: Merging Subtrees
hints.text: When merging left child L and right child R, if L.suf_char == R.pre_char, a new contiguous repeating block spans across their boundary.

hints.title: Segment Tree Point Update Implementation

complexity.notes: Tree initialization takes O(n) and each query takes O(log n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing longest repeating substring after each update is O(q * n) and TLEs.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Segment tree takes 4 * n node space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate implements interval segment tree merging prefix, suffix, and internal maxima.
